row: Hope In The Valley Equine Rescue

Horses from all walks of life, can find a safe and welcoming place at Hope In The Valley Equine Rescue and Sanctuary in Valley Center, KS.  Since 2005, the rescue has helped over 500 horses, donkeys, and mules find a better life.

Horses can be offered hope in emergency situations where their owners have passed or can no longer provide for them, in the event of neglect or abandonment cases under investigation by law enforcement, or on the occasion when the Hope Team finds an equine in need of rescue at auction.

Hope exists to rescue, rehabilitate, reconnect, and rehome –

“To Give Them A Better Life”.
